summary: The states a read lands in, kept distinct all the way to the screen: loading, failed, empty, and the content. A failure is headed by what the server answered, with its diagnostic and the problems it named under the heading and Try again; a failed read of secondary data is a warning about part of the page. Drawn in a box of its own, or unframed inside a panel.

anatomy.frame: The row a state is drawn in. By default a box of its own on the card's ground that keeps its height in a column; unframed, the same row with no box, no ground and no edge in any tone, and a panel's padding, for a state inside a panel (a table's, a section's body).
anatomy.spinner: Loading: a turning ring before the word.
anatomy.mark: A failed read: an alert mark at the row's start, level with the heading's first line; a triangle in the warning tone.
anatomy.heading: A failed read's heading, by what the server answered: words.unreachable when no answer came, words.missing for a 404 (an absence, not a refusal), words.partRefused in the warning tone, else words.refused. A plain line, or the page's h1 or a part's h2 (headingLevel). Announced as an alert, politely in the warning tone.
anatomy.diagnostic: The server's own words under the heading, or a sentence the app wrote in their place.
anatomy.code: A backticked part of a written diagnostic or problem: in the code face on a muted chip.
anatomy.problems: Each failure a refusal named, as a problem document's errors, in a bulleted list under the diagnostic.
anatomy.retry: With onRetry: Try again, an outline button with a turning arrow, under the diagnostic.
anatomy.message: Empty: the one line the app gives (emptyMessage), in the frame.
anatomy.emptyContent: Empty with more than a sentence: the app's own empty state (emptyRender), such as a way to make the first one, drawn in the frame's place as given.
anatomy.content: The read came back with something: the content, drawn as given; the state draws nothing of its own.

loading.does: The read is on its way.

error.does: What the server said when it refused, or a sentence the app wrote in its place; written as text, its backticked parts are in the code face.

problems.does: Each failure a refusal named, listed under the diagnostic, such as a problem document's errors.

status.does: How the read came back: an HTTP status, or unreachable when no answer came. It picks the heading.

empty.does: The read came back with nothing.

emptyMessage.does: The one line an empty read states.

emptyRender.does: An empty state that is more than a sentence, drawn in place of the frame.

onRetry.does: Reads again after a failure, from Try again under the diagnostic.

tone.does: critical: the page's own read failed. warning: a read of secondary data the page stands without, said in the warning tone, headed as a part of the page that could not be read.

headingLevel.does: What a failure's heading is: h1 where the state stands in for a whole page (a detail page whose record failed to load), so the page still has its heading; h2 for a part under the page's own; a plain line otherwise.

frame.does: Draws the state in a box of its own; false drops the box, for a state that sits in a panel already.

children.does: The content, drawn when the read came back with something.

frame.note: Framed. Its pieces set at the top; loading centers them.

mark.note: layout.markTop down from the row's top, level with the heading's first line.

lines.note: The heading, the diagnostic and the list of problems.

column.note: Between those lines and Try again.

retry.note: parts/button at sm, outline, with its icon.

markTop.note: The mark's top below the row's: its center at 10, level with the heading's first line.

problemsInset.note: The list's start pad: its discs hang in it, so a wrapped line starts under its own text.

rest.means: The read came back with something: the content is drawn, and the state draws nothing.
rest.reached: not loading, no error, not empty

loading.means: The read is on its way: a spinner and words.loading.

failed.means: The read failed: the mark, the heading by what the server answered, the diagnostic and the problems under it, and Try again with onRetry.

empty.means: The read came back with nothing: one line, or the app's own empty state. Never drawn while loading.
empty.reached: empty, with no error, while not loading

warning.means: A failed read of secondary data the page stands without: the warning's mark, and in a box its wash and edge, headed as a part of the page that could not be read.

unframed.means: No box of its own, and no ground or edge in any tone: the row padded as a panel's, for a state inside a panel.

rest.note: Not drawn: the content stands in its place.

failed+warning+unframed.note: Unframed means no ground and no edge in every tone: the mark and the heading say the warning.

loading.note: It turns, and keeps turning when motion is reduced.

rest.note: Drawn only for a failed read.
Drawn only for a failed read.

failed.note: The ink around the state: foreground on the page, and on a card or a panel.

rest.note: Drawn only for a failed read.
Drawn only in a failed read's words.
Drawn only for a failed read that names them.

failed.note: A disc before each, the list padded 16 at its start.

rest.note: Drawn only for a failed read, with onRetry.

words.partRefused: Part of this page could not be read

appText.error: What the server said, or the app's sentence in its place.
appText.empty: The one line an empty read states, or the app's own empty state.

sokkel-ui: Loading is role=status; a failure is role=alert, or role=status in the warning tone.
pageStateHeading picks the heading from status and tone; DataTable says its own failed read with it too, as an unframed PageState under its heads (parts/table).
A string diagnostic or problem is drawn by ProseText, its backticked parts as code.
The spinner is animate-spin, which motion.css leaves turning when motion is reduced.
emptyRender and children are drawn as given, with no frame.
sokkel-ui-egui: The app picks the state by its constructor (loading, refused, missing, unreachable, empty) rather than by an HTTP status; the headings are the same.
show returns true when Try again was pressed; retry(true) draws it.
An empty state with more than a sentence is the app's own drawing in the state's place, such as Empty; the content is the app's own drawing too.

drift.spec: A bulleted list padded 16 at its start, its lines with nothing between them, a wrapped line starting under its own text.
drift.today: Each problem a label of its own after a bullet and two spaces, 4 apart; a wrapped line runs under the bullet.

drift.spec: Backticked parts in the code face on a muted chip, radius-sm, padded 4 across.
Try again with a turning arrow before the word.
2 below the row's top, its center at 10.
drift.today: Centered in a 22 tall slot, its center at 11.

As of dfb6079, PageState draws loading, refused, missing, not answering, a part refused and empty, framed or not, in both tones, with the diagnostic, the problems and Try again, and words as fields. Not yet: headingLevel (the heading as the page's h1 or a part's h2 for AccessKit), and the announcements (polite while loading and for a warning, an alert for a failure).
